rules.urgency: General help medium; explicit urgency high; relaxed low absent severe danger; repeated failure usually medium; danger overrides tone; unintelligible unknown.
rules.events: Missed promised callback and unanswered warranty are two independently evidenced events; paraphrase alone is one.
rules.importance: Follow up together is not equal importance. Drawer, collection and invoice retained; business order separate; dependency needs source.
rules.safety: Detached cold saucepan handle and sparks near socket during kettle use severe/high; ordinary drawer collision minor/medium; no injury does not remove severe potential harm.
rules.billing: billing/invoice issue -> customer_support coordination; neither refund nor proven fault; v2 other/unclear diagnostic.
rules.reply: Main customer language or explicit request; check repeated requests, main request, disclaimers, invented actions, material promises, safety/privacy, all issues separately; unsent/unreviewed.
rules.adoption: Adopt approved 11 P3.7 rewrites with new hashes and no inherited references; retain old versions and 20 representatives; 128 pending.
rules.adversarial: P35-073 remains adversarial development, excluded from natural email quality denominator.
